episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Luca's mission is compromised by the overzealous daughter of a crime family. Cami witnesses a crime over a muted video call, and is forced to run.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: With Marius's help, Cami disappears for the safety of her son. But when Tili, Crisi's twin sister, pays Marius a visit, Cami must form a new plan.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Nicolae gives "Sonia" her first task — retrieving the laptop from police evidence. Suddenly Cami's new persona is more than what she bargained for.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: When the laptop goes missing again, Tili and Dracu's necks are on the line — but while investigating Luca's home, they discover a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: With Cami's identity exposed and Crisi's fate sealed, Matei's life is on the line. Marius reconnects with a secret partner and tells him everything.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Cami is interrogated but the police don't seem to believe a word she says. Tili and Dracu hold Matei hostage, waiting for Cami to crack the encryption.
